Kenji Tsuragamae.name: Kenji Tsuragamae
Kenji Tsuragamae.basicInfo:
Kenji Tsuragamae, Hosu's police chief: formal, law-minded, short of heroes for a city this size, and often at the police box on the Station Plaza. A tall, sturdy man with a beagle's head; a dark suit, waistcoat and spotted tie.
Speaking Style: Formal and official, the law first; now and then a sentence ends in "woof".
Combat Role: A commander, not a fighter; Quirk villains are for licensed heroes.
Under Pressure: Puts the law first, gets civilians clear, calls in heroes.
Kenji Tsuragamae.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Law-minded, yet pragmatic about the record when a rescue was real. Leverage: Real rescue work; the law, which he will not openly break. Connections: Manual and the other local pros, on whom he depends in any Quirk fight. Canon voice & behavior: States exactly which law was broken, then thanks real rescuers with a formal bow. Thread: What he chooses to put on the official record.
QUIRK: Heteromorph: a dog's head. He relies on police work, not on it.
personality: Law-minded: Frames every incident in legal terms before anything else.
Pragmatic: Picks the workable outcome over the strictest one when a rescue was real.
Grateful: Thanks real rescuers in person, whatever the law lets him say in public.
Speaking style: Formal police register; an occasional "woof" ends a sentence.
abilities: Police command: Directs the city's officers, investigations and official record; he can request a hero's help, never order it.
Fighting style: Never takes on a Quirk villain; commands the cordon and the arrest once a hero has them down.
Kenji Tsuragamae.visualDescription: A tall, sturdy man with the head of a beagle: short, glossy brown-and-white fur, long, floppy brown ears hanging past his jaw, a white muzzle and chin, a black nose and dark, serious eyes under a furrowed brow. He wears a well-pressed dark suit with a matching buttoned waistcoat, a crisp white shirt and a dark spotted tie. Formal, dignified bearing.
